package telegram

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const (
	telegramStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	telegramTeacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	telegramDialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	telegramCode      = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
)

type telegramTeacherStub struct{}

func (telegramTeacherStub) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: telegramTeacherID, StudentID: telegramStudentID}, nil
}

type telegramDialogStub struct {
	key     string
	channel domain.DialogMessageChannel
}

func (stub *telegramDialogStub) EnsureTeacherDialog(context.Context, string, string, domain.LearningContextType, string) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: telegramDialogID, StudentID: telegramStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: telegramTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}, nil
}

func (stub *telegramDialogStub) AppendStudentChannelMessage(_ context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, key string, channel domain.DialogMessageChannel, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	stub.key, stub.channel = key, channel
	return domain.DialogMessage{ID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", DialogID: binding.ID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Channel: channel, SenderID: binding.StudentID, Body: body}, nil
}

type telegramStoreStub struct {
	digest  [32]byte
	record  domain.TelegramLinkRecord
	binding domain.TelegramBinding
}

func (stub *telegramStoreStub) IssueLinkCode(_ context.Context, digest [32]byte, record domain.TelegramLinkRecord) error {
	stub.digest, stub.record = digest, record
	return nil
}
func (stub *telegramStoreStub) ConsumeLinkCode(context.Context, [32]byte, int64, int64, time.Time) (domain.TelegramBinding, error) {
	return stub.binding, nil
}
func (stub *telegramStoreStub) GetBindingByChat(context.Context, int64, int64) (domain.TelegramBinding, error) {
	return stub.binding, nil
}

type tokenStub struct{ value string }

func (stub tokenStub) NewID() string { return stub.value }

type clockStub struct{ value time.Time }

func (stub clockStub) Now() time.Time { return stub.value }

func TestIssueLinkCodeStoresOnlyDigestAndGeneralDialogBinding(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	store := &telegramStoreStub{}
	dialogs := &telegramDialogStub{}
	service := Service{
		Teachers: telegramTeacherStub{}, Dialogs: dialogs, Messages: dialogs, Store: store,
		Tokens: tokenStub{value: telegramCode}, Clock: clockStub{value: now}, BotUsername: "personal_teacher_bot",
	}
	link, err := service.IssueLinkCode(context.Background(), telegramStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, telegramCode, link.Code)
	require.Equal(t, sha256.Sum256([]byte(telegramCode)), store.digest)
	require.Equal(t, telegramDialogID, store.record.DialogID)
	require.Equal(t, "https://t.me/personal_teacher_bot?start="+telegramCode, link.BotURL)
}

func TestProcessUpdateReusesStudentBindingAndStableDialogIdempotency(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	store := &telegramStoreStub{binding: domain.TelegramBinding{
		StudentID: telegramStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: telegramTeacherID, DialogID: telegramDialogID,
		TelegramUserID: 42, ChatID: 42, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}}
	dialogs := &telegramDialogStub{}
	service := Service{Messages: dialogs, Store: store, Clock: clockStub{value: now}}
	update := domain.TelegramInboundUpdate{UpdateID: 99, TelegramUserID: 42, ChatID: 42, ChatType: "private", Text: "Объясни интерфейсы"}
	result, err := service.ProcessUpdate(context.Background(), update)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, result.Accepted)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram, dialogs.channel)
	firstKey := dialogs.key
	_, err = service.ProcessUpdate(context.Background(), update)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, firstKey, dialogs.key)
}

func TestProcessStartConsumesOneTimeCode(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	store := &telegramStoreStub{binding: domain.TelegramBinding{
		StudentID: telegramStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: telegramTeacherID, DialogID: telegramDialogID,
		TelegramUserID: 42, ChatID: 42, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}}
	result, err := (Service{Store: store, Messages: &telegramDialogStub{}, Clock: clockStub{value: now}}).ProcessUpdate(
		context.Background(), domain.TelegramInboundUpdate{UpdateID: 1, TelegramUserID: 42, ChatID: 42, ChatType: "private", Text: "/start " + telegramCode},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, result.Accepted)
	require.Contains(t, result.ReplyText, "тот же персональный учитель")
}
